_comment: Pre-baked Phase-2 agent_outputs for the triple-scan review pipelines (veto_diff_review / veto_ci_gate / veto_pr_review / veto_full_review / veto_pre_commit). Each scenario is keyed by the scan task id (scan-review = reviewer, scan-sec = security-scanner, scan-secrets = secrets) and shaped to match buildAnalysisPrompt in src/agents/llm-runner.ts. Passing one of these as the `agent_outputs` argument short-circuits the agentic loop and drives the pipeline to a real verdict. finalizeTripleScan rule: fail when any scan has critical_count > 0 (secrets blocks on any finding); warn on high_count > 0; otherwise pass.

scan-review.subject: Add a typed config loader
scan-review.summary: Clean change with clear naming and no correctness or maintainability concerns.

scan-sec.subject: Add a typed config loader
scan-sec.summary: No injection, auth, or insecure-deserialization issues detected.

scan-secrets.subject: Add a typed config loader
scan-secrets.summary: No hardcoded credentials, API keys, or tokens found.

scan-review.subject: Refactor request handler

findings.description: The promise rejection in fetchUser() is swallowed, so transient failures surface as a generic 500 with no log.
findings.fix: Catch and log the rejection, then return a typed error to the caller.

scan-review.summary: Functional but has one high-severity error-handling gap worth fixing before merge.

scan-review.subject: Add admin delete endpoint

findings.description: deleteUser() runs before the auth guard resolves, so unauthenticated requests can delete records.
findings.fix: Await requireAuth(req) before performing the delete and return 401 on failure.

scan-review.summary: Critical authorization-ordering bug allows unauthenticated deletes.

scan-sec.subject: Add admin delete endpoint

findings.description: User-supplied id is concatenated directly into the SQL DELETE statement, enabling SQL injection.
findings.fix: Use a parameterized query / prepared statement for the id binding.

scan-sec.summary: SQL injection in the delete path; must be parameterized before merge.

scan-secrets.subject: Add admin delete endpoint

findings.description: A live AWS secret access key is hardcoded in the new config constant.
findings.fix: Remove the key, rotate it immediately, and load it from an environment variable or secret manager.

scan-secrets.summary: Hardcoded AWS credential committed; rotate and externalize.
